item.title: iYogaImages.com Website Redesign & E-commerce

Site is currently hosted on Square. And the domain is also parked on Square. I would like you to move it to GoDaddy. Acceptance criteria: 1. item.title: WordPress Content & Social Media Support
item.description: 2-8 USD/hr | We are a small residential cleaning business serving customers in Massachusetts. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented freelancer to publish blog articles on our WordPress website and manage our three existing social media accounts. We will provide the article text. You will handle WordPress formatting and publishing, images, internal linking, basic on-page SEO, and social media scheduling. For privacy reasons, business identifying information and account links will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the interview process. Workload and Budget • Hourly rate: $5/hour • Initial trial: 4 weeks • Maximum workload: 8 hours per week • Weekly budget: $40 • Expected output: 2 published articles per week and approximately 3 posts per social media platform per week. Please confirm that you can complete the work within this schedule and budget. Hours must be tracked, and additional hours require approval in advance. 1. WordPress Blog Publishing Publish two articles per week using our existing WordPress website. We will supply the article text. Your responsibilities include: • Format articles with readable paragraphs, headings, lists, and appropriate spacing. • Find suitable images or create relevant images using AI. • Use royalty-free image sources such as: o https://www.pexels.com/ o https://unsplash.com/ o https://pixabay.com/ • Verify applicable image licenses and keep records of image sources. • Optimize images, use descriptive filenames, and add useful alt text. • Add a featured image and other relevant images as needed. • Write an appropriate SEO title and meta description using the existing SEO plugin. • Use one clear H1 heading and logical H2/H3 subheadings. • Check formatting, spelling, and links before publishing. • Provide the live URL for each published article. Articles should provide helpful information to homeowners about residential house cleaning. Images should primarily show indoor cleaning, including kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas. Do not copy images from Google Images or other websites without permission. 2. Internal Linking and On-Page SEO Each article should help readers discover relevant services and other useful website content. Please follow these guidelines: • Link naturally to one or two relevant service pages where appropriate. • Link to a relevant city-specific page when it genuinely helps the reader. • Link to related blog articles as the blog grows. • Use descriptive anchor text instead of repeatedly inserting exact-match keywords. • Avoid keyword stuffing and unnecessary links. • Verify that all destination URLs are correct and working. • Follow the existing website URL structure. • Do not change URLs, redirects, technical SEO settings, or existing page content without approval. 3. Social Media Management Manage three existing business social media accounts: Facebook, Instagram, and X. Account details will be provided during the interview process. Expected workload: approximately three posts per platform per week. Responsibilities include: • Create and schedule posts based on our supplied articles, cleaning tips, seasonal topics, and service information. • Adapt captions for each platform rather than copying identical text everywhere. • Use relevant images or graphics. • Share article links and other relevant website links where appropriate. • Focus on residential cleaning and the local communities served by the business. • Maintain a professional, helpful, consistent brand voice. • Check comments and messages within the allotted hours and notify us of potential customer inquiries. • Do not purchase followers, use spam tactics, or run paid advertising without approval. You may repurpose useful information from the weekly articles to create social posts, so you do not need to develop nine completely different topics every week. 4. Weekly Reporting Provide a brief weekly report containing: • The two published article URLs. • Images used and their sources. • Internal links added. • Links to social media posts published on each platform. • Total hours worked. • Any issues or recommendations. 5. Requirements Applicants should have: • Experience publishing articles in WordPress. • Basic knowledge of on-page SEO, metadata, image optimization, and internal linking. • Experience managing Facebook, Instagram, and X business accounts. • Good written English and strong attention to detail. • The ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines. • The ability to work independently within a limited weekly budget. Please include examples of WordPress articles you have published and social media accounts you have managed. Explain how you would organize this work within 8 hours per week. 6. Four-Week Paid Trial We will begin with a four-week paid trial. We will evaluate article quality, image selection, internal links, social media posts, communication, and reliability before deciding whether to continue. The 8-hour weekly limit is firm unless additional hours are approved in advance. Quality and accuracy are more important than publishing rushed or incomplete work. To apply, please confirm your availability, relevant experience, and ability to meet the weekly workload at $5/hour.

item.title: # WordPress Drone Photography & Videography Website — Mechanicsville Aerial - Fully Hosted and Ready to Launch -- 2
item.description:
30-250 USD | PROJECT: WordPress Drone Photography Website — Mechanicsville Aerial
PROJECT OVERVIEW
I need a professional, fully functional WordPress website for Mechanicsville Aerial, my drone photography and videography business located in Mechanicsville, Virginia.
I own MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM and its associated email domain. The website must be fully built, hosted, tested, and live on my domain before final delivery so I can launch immediately.
The website will showcase my aerial photography and video work and generate customer inquiries and quote requests. Online payments are not required initially, but the website must support adding payment functionality in the future.
I have already paid for a confidentiality agreement. The developer must honor its terms and protect my business information, media, and project materials.
1. WEBSITE DESIGN
Create a modern, professional, mobile-friendly website that works well on computers, tablets, and smartphones.
Include: - Home page - Photography gallery - Video gallery - Services page - Request a Quote / Check Availability page - About page - Contact page - Privacy policy and other necessary standard pages
The design should emphasize attractive aerial imagery, simple navigation, fast loading, and clear calls to action.
2. PHOTOGRAPHY AND VIDEO
The website must accommodate at least 200 photographs, with original files potentially 48 MB each, and at least 75 video clips approximately eight seconds long.
Provide sufficient storage, bandwidth, backups, and efficient media delivery. Use optimized images, thumbnails, and compressed video previews to maintain performance while preserving my original high-resolution files.
The site must support adding more media over time. Explain storage limits, video hosting arrangements, bandwidth limitations, and any additional charges. I must retain control of my original media and any third-party hosting accounts.
3. EASY ADMINISTRATION
I must be able to manage the website without programming knowledge.
Provide a simple WordPress administration interface that allows me to: - Upload, publish, replace, and delete photographs and videos. - Organize galleries into categories. - Edit page content, services, and contact information. - Manage quote requests and customer inquiries. - View and manage email subscribers.
Provide written instructions or a short tutorial showing me how to perform these tasks.
4. QUOTE REQUESTS AND CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION
Visitors must be able to inquire about drone photography and videography services and request pricing or availability.
The form should collect name, email, optional phone number, requested service, project location, preferred date, and project details.
When a request is submitted: - I receive an email notification at my designated business email. - The customer receives an automatic acknowledgment. - The inquiry is saved securely in WordPress. - I can review and track inquiries through the administration area. - I can respond to customers through the website's administration interface using integrated email functionality. - I can review previous inquiries and responses.
Include spam protection and test all functions before launch.
5. EMAIL COLLECTION AND MARKETING
Include an optional newsletter signup form to collect email addresses from prospective customers and existing customers who want business updates.
Provide subscriber management, exportable email lists, appropriate consent language, and unsubscribe functionality. Quote requests must not automatically enroll customers in marketing emails without appropriate consent.
Identify any additional email marketing service fees.
6. BUSINESS EMAIL AND DOMAIN
Configure the website to work with my existing MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM domain and professional email.
Integrate my current email provider where possible, or recommend an appropriate business email service. Configure and test email delivery, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records where applicable.
Test inquiry notifications, customer acknowledgments, and replies.
My domain and existing email accounts must remain under my control. Do not transfer, cancel, or disrupt existing services without my approval.
7. SEO AND SOCIAL MEDIA
Implement sound technical, on-page, and local SEO practices to help attract customers in Mechanicsville, Richmond, Hanover County, and surrounding Virginia communities.
Include: - Search-friendly page titles, descriptions, headings, and URLs. - XML sitemap and descriptive image alt text. - Mobile optimization and good page performance. - Appropriate local business structured data. - Google Search Console and analytics integration where available. - Social media sharing links and attractive previews. - Clear quote-request calls to action.
Use relevant terms naturally, including drone photography, aerial photography, drone videography, real estate aerial photography, and Mechanicsville, Virginia.
Optimize the website for search visibility and social sharing. No guaranteed search rankings or social media exposure are expected.
8. FUTURE ONLINE PAYMENTS
Online payments are not required at launch. However, use a maintainable WordPress architecture that will allow a secure payment gateway and future service deposits or payments to be added without rebuilding the website.
Do not activate paid payment services without my approval.
9. HOSTING, SECURITY, AND LAUNCH
This is a turnkey project. I require a fully functional, hosted website live on MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM before final acceptance, not merely website files or a design.
The developer must: - Configure suitable WordPress hosting, domain connection, and SSL/HTTPS. - Install and configure WordPress, the theme, and necessary plugins. - Implement appropriate security and automated backups. - Configure email and inquiry notifications. - Test the website on desktop and mobile devices. - Test galleries, video playback, forms, and email communication. - Deliver a complete website backup and restoration instructions. - Provide administrator access and operating instructions. - Identify all paid themes, plugins, licenses, hosting plans, and recurring charges.
Disclose all ongoing costs and hosting limitations before work begins.
10. OWNERSHIP AND CONFIDENTIALITY
I require full ownership and administrative control of the completed website and all deliverables, subject to applicable third-party licenses and the project agreement.
The domain must remain in my account. Hosting and related accounts must be registered in my name or transferred to my control.
Upon final payment, provide: - Complete WordPress website files and database. - Custom graphics and assets created for the project. - Administrator credentials and access to relevant accounts. - A complete downloadable website backup. - Operating and restoration instructions. - A list of plugins, themes, licenses, subscriptions, and renewal costs. - The agreed ownership and usage rights for custom work.
I must be able to hire another developer without being locked into proprietary arrangements. Do not retain exclusive control over the domain, hosting, website, or customer information. Honor the existing confidentiality agreement.
11. ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
The project is complete only when the website is live, functional, and under my control.
Before final acceptance, demonstrate that: 1. The domain opens securely. 2. Photo galleries and videos work - Items in photo and video should be watermarked and have a price tag so that visitors can purchase COPIES of items in the galleries photo or video clip. 3. I can add and remove media without programming. 4. Quote requests are stored and email notifications work. 5. I can respond to customers through the website administration interface. 6. Email collection, consent, and unsubscribe functions work. 7. Business email integration is tested. 8. SEO basics and social sharing previews are configured. 9. Backups, documentation, and administrator access are delivered. 10. Storage limits, ongoing expenses, and licenses are documented. 11. Ownership and confidentiality requirements are satisfied.
Please provide a fixed-price proposal, estimated delivery schedule, hosting recommendations, recurring costs, and a list of included and excluded features. Identify limitations before work begins.
The final product must be a professional, fully operational WordPress website, hosted and ready for immediate launch, with room for future growth.

item.title: UI UX Designer required
item.description:

The current product works, but the visual language feels dated and the buying flow is longer than it should be. My goal is to boost conversions and make the shopping journey effortless on both desktop and mobile.
Here’s what I’d like from you: • A fresh, conversion-focused visual direction that still respects our brand palette and typography. • Refined information architecture and user flows that shorten the path from first visit to checkout. • Interactive wireframes and high-fidelity mockups delivered in Figma (or Sketch/Adobe XD if you prefer) for every key screen—home, category, product detail, cart, checkout, and account dashboard. • A lightweight design system (color, typography, spacing, reusable components) so our dev team can implement efficiently. • Responsive breakpoints and accessibility considerations baked in.
I’ll share the current site, analytics highlights, and user feedback once we start so you can pinpoint friction points. Collaborate with me on two rounds of refinements; final sign-off files should be neatly organized and ready for hand-off to development.
If you thrive on data-driven design, understand e-commerce best practices, and craft everything by hand, I’m ready to get started.

item.title: Scalable Pet Classifieds Platform
item.description:
250-750 USD | I want to launch a full-featured classifieds website devoted to dog and cat breeds—something in the spirit of petclassifieds.com or puppies.com—yet flexible enough to grow far beyond a simple listing board. The core build must handle high traffic, thousands of concurrent listings, and an intuitive journey for both sellers and buyers on desktop and mobile.
Key platform pillars • User registration with robust profile pages for breeders, shelters, and private sellers • End-to-end listing creation and management, including bulk upload and media galleries • Secure payment processing so sellers can boost posts, reserve deposits, or pay listing fees • Category hierarchy that starts with Dog and Cat breeds (purebred and cross-references for mixed later) • Smart search, advanced filters, and location radius so buyers quickly narrow results • Image-rich detail pages plus a reviews & ratings layer to build trust
The build has to be mobile first, SEO-ready, and AI friendly from the outset. For example, I’d like to explore AI tools that can: • Auto-tag photos with likely breeds to speed up listing creation • Flag potential scam wording or duplicate ads • Recommend similar pets to shoppers in real time
I’m open on the stack—Laravel, Django, MERN, or a headless CMS paired with React/Vue are all possibilities—as long as the architecture scales horizontally and you document the APIs. Please outline: 1. Your proposed tech stack and why it suits a large classifieds site. 2. Past projects that demonstrate you’ve built high-load marketplaces or animal-related portals. 3. A milestone plan covering database schema design, core module rollout, AI layer integration, QA, and launch.
Feel free to highlight any performance, security, or DevOps practices you’d bring to keep the platform fast and resilient. I look forward to seeing examples of your work and hearing how you’d turn this idea into a polished, scalable reality.

item.title: Wix Site Build From Design

Transparency on the factors driving each score is important so I can tweak my acquisition criteria. • Multi-channel outreach: once a lead is approved, the platform should launch pre-configured SMS, e-mail, ringless voicemail, and postcard campaigns, then track every touchpoint in one timeline. • Conversation automation: integrate a GPT-style conversational agent that can handle routine seller questions and book calls into my calendar while handing complex threads off to me or my acquisitions manager. • Negotiation & contract workflow: auto-populate offer numbers, generate state-specific purchase agreements, route them for e-signature, and store everything in a secure deal folder. • Deal pipeline dashboard: Kanban or similar view showing lead → offer → under contract → closed, with projected profit and time to close calculations. • Mobile first: a companion app for both iOS and Android so I can review comps, fire off messages, or sign docs on the go.
Acceptance criteria 1. End-to-end demo that starts with raw data import and finishes with a signed test contract. 2. Accuracy metrics for lead scoring and outreach delivery provided in a written report. 3. Source code, model notebooks, and setup scripts delivered in a private repository with clear README. 4. Deployment documents for both cloud hosting and App Store / Play Store submission.
If you have prior experience mingling AI, prop-tech data feeds, and transactional workflows, let’s talk about milestones and timelines—I’m ready to move quickly.
